notes.title: Diplomacy UI + Trade system reworked
notes.content:
=Patch 0.4.14.886=

[b]Trade system renewed[/b]

Merchants can now choose which resource they buy from each town. Move the merchant to the resource site within the town area, and initiate "extend route" action.

Only capitals are excluded from this arrangement. What capitals sell or buy depend on the owner's offers and demands, which are set in the Trade UI in the ledger. The trade UI can also be used to boycott, tax or even subsidize traders of particular factions.

This new system makes it easier to make routes profitable.

[b]Diplomacy UI[/b]

Diplomacy UI is now available in the ledger!

[b]Grudge[/b]

The diplomatic state is determined by the grudge between factions. Every faction holds a degree of grudge to another. It is changed depending on the opponent's actions, such as expansion, battles, trespassing, trade relations, gifts, etc. Passed a certain threshold the grudge causes war declaration, spontenaously. 

Peace can be offered again, once the grudge is fallen enough, peace can be offered by agents with diplomat trait (under development)

notes.content:

notes.title: New Mechanics and UI Overhaul is here!
notes.content:
--Playtest Patch Notes--

This is probably most extensive update IA ever received. A brief list is as follows;

[b]=New Trade Mechanics=[/b]
Now trade brings more challenge. Merchants can create trade routes along a series of towns, of which the order impacts how profitable the route can be. Check out the "Trade Routes" tutorial for more details...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244034/a530206118286a61015ecce0ef597134c59be552.png[/img]

[b]=New Replantation Mechanics=[/b]
Now replantation depends on three parameters, humidity, shade and temperature. Each plant has certain requirements of these parameters which are not apparent to the player at the beginning. Finding the right conditions will require a series of tests and deduction. Good luck royal botanists! Tutorial is on the way...

[b]=New Self-sustainability Mechanics=[/b]
Now a town can still survive even without no logistic connection to the capital using the food resources in their vicinity. 

[b]=Gameplay=[/b]
The game begins with whole Europe revealed.

[b]=UI=[/b]
All UI has been updated with more stylish look with paper and wood theme. Including a Ledger designed with gameplay flow in mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244034/eca779bcf90aa871cb558f94e6ac8655651415c2.png[/img]

Portuguese, Turkish and Romanian translations are added.

[b]=Fixes=[/b]
Save N load system issues are fixed. Older Saves would not work.

[b]=Tutorials=[/b]
Several new Tutorials are added. These are; 

Supply and Demand
Ore Discovery
Recruitment and Regiments
Exploration and Colonization
Navigation and Battle
Trade Routes
and more on the way...

Note: New playtesters will be given access starting now! Feel free to share with your friends!

notes.title: Feature Packed Patch is Here!
notes.content:
[h3]=New Mechanics=[/h3]
Freelancer demand: Any labor that is not assigned will be demand for raw resources. In return they will pay the market price. This replaces tax system.

Experience system: Now upgrades require experience, which is gained through action abilities. Player can have more than one upgrade, however the required experience raises logarithmically.

[h3]=Gameplay Changes=[/h3]
Merchant Upgrade: Entrepreneur can hire convicts or destitute citizens to settle in the new world. Must settle next to valuable resources. Will reset the class progress.

Seasick, Frostbite and SunBurnt traits: These traits are dependent on how many turns that a unit spend in the sea/snow/desert. While SeaSick decreases discipline and movement points, Frostbite and SunBurnt decreases hitpoints and movementpoints.

Now citizens born to other citizens born tier lower then their parents, unless they are lowest tier classes, peasants or slaves. ie. children of a master is automatically artisan.

Units can only be disbanded in the capital. Disbanding no longer removes the occupation. They can be reassembled in the assemble window. This is so the parties can be reorganized.

[h3]=Visuals=[/h3]
With the new ocean shader, seas will look even more realistic!

[h3]=Music=[/h3]
Serviam by Emil Posner is added to the campaign

[h3]=Fixes=[/h3]
Save n load system issues. 

Save file version check is added.

notes.title: New patch includes: New labor system, Save N Load system, new UI artwork
notes.content:
Patch Notes since 0.1.8.575:

== UI ==
New UI art includes more use of ribbons. It also keeps the borders less distruptive.


== Gameplay ==
Load'N Save system enables saving your progress and continue later. Works in Playtest scene.

New labor system makes an equal distribution of laborers more rewarding. Labor is now calculated based on two parameters, base labor and labor boost. Lower tier citizens, slaves, peasants and apprentices, has only base labor, while higher tier citizens has both, base labor and a labor boost. Labor boost is multiplied with the total base labor in the town and added to the final labor.

Salt resource is now among the already discovered resources.

Changes in the UI and labor system requires reworking the tutorials. So Tutorials are disabled for the being.


== Fixes ==
Target FPS is set to 60. This is done to avoid GPU overdrive in the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8.559 introduces refugees!
notes.content:
=Patch Notes=

Mechanics
Town occupation mechanics get additional behaviour. When a town being invaded, if the citizens are prefer resisting, yet the enemy is overwhelming, then the citizens will choose to form a refugee and flee instead of defending. This will cause instability in the areas neighboring warzones. Refugees move as soon as they are created.

Culture traits are now added to the game. Currently cultures do not have any significant impact, but it will improve the communication between citizens and agents in future updates.

Balancing
Building quarries now cost 70 AP instead of 80.

Rennes is renamed as Nantes.

notes.title: Battle and Siege Overhaul is here!
notes.content:
[b]=Patch Notes=[/b]

[b][h3]Citizens will now defend their homes![/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*]Town occupation mechanics completely modified. When trying to enter an enemy town, the citizens can assemble to form militia and defend the town as long as they have reasons to do so. Another reason to keep them happy.
[*] Seize Town ability has higher chance of success to balance the aforementioned. (More changes here in the upcoming updates.)
[*] Entering towns now cost 20 extra Action Points to balance.
[/olist]
[b][h3]More complex battles![/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*] The melee attack, ranged attack, armor and other factors are now considered to calculate damage.
[*] The melee attacks now damage in both ways. Also costs action points to both parties.
[*] For ranged attack, if the line of sight is partially blocked, only half of the damage will be inflicted.
[*] Regiment strengths and expected damages are now shown before the battle.
[*] Post battle indicators will show the damage inflicted.
[/olist]
[b][h3]Searching for resources is now more rewarding![/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*] When geologist finds a resource, +3 of that resource is added to the warehouse as a reward. 
[*] If there is only resource nearby, then players are informed about its trace. If the trace of the resource is found, +1 of that resource is added to the warehouse.
[*] Resource rewards are now shown above the geologist.
[/olist]
[b][h3]More information will be flowing onto the screen[/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*] All events will show information on the top right of the screen.
[/olist]

[b]Fix[/b]: Selecting regiments in same tile won't cause vertical shift.
[b]Fix[/b]: Exiting game while End turn is running no longer cause stuck units in the next game session.
[b]Fix[/b]: Other rare errors.

notes.title: Finally, players can found new towns!
notes.content:
==Patch Notes==

[h3]Choose unit upgrades[/h3]
Newly recruited explorers can now choose a skill; Geologist or Urban Planner.

[h3]Found new towns[/h3]
Explorers with Urban Planner skill can hire settlers from player's towns and found new towns. These towns need to be located at least 2 tiles away from any owned land.

[h3]Criminals can be convicted[/h3]
Smugglers can now be detained and convicted by units. 15% chance that units convict smugglers or bandits in the town. This results in removal of any existing smuggling route.

[h3]Performance updates[/h3]
Some performance issues due to survey overlay when an explorer or builder is selected is fixed with expected performance increase up to 20 FPS.

1. Reproduction traits: Expected Parent, Recent Parent, Parent traits are added to build up the way to creation of new units. This process currently fast (ie.3 months pregnancy) for testing.

2. New resource type, Grapes, are added.

notes.title: Religion, Discrimination and Unrest Traits are here!
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]


1.1. [u]Discrimination traits:[/u] [b]Estranged, Discriminated and Unwanted[/b]
discrimination occurs when citizens are excluded from the community by being in a different religion, or different wealth

1.2. [u]Religion traits: [/u][b]Catholic, Protestant, Orthodox, Coptic, Sunni, Shia, Jewish, Animist and Fetishist[/b]
religion can spread inside towns or between towns and armies. Religion type, positive traits, melancholy and other factors impact. Besides religions, we also have [b]Newly Convert and True Believer[/b] traits. Citizens with these traits do not tend to be converted easily.

1.3. [u]Unrest traits: [/u][b]Protesting, On Strike and Rioting[/b]
These traits occur in the same order, leading to actions such as vandalism, massacre and rebellion [actions are not yet implemented]. Moving units in town helps to calm down the unrest. Also depression can lead to [b]Hysterical [/b]trait, which increases reactivity of the citizens. So keep extra eye on hysterical citizens.

2. Warning signs when a given production order will not be met in current resource or labor supply. This is most likely to happen if an order left from previous turn cannot be met anymore.

3. Added cliffy shores back

4. Several small fixes

notes.title: Unit animations are here!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
[list]
[*]Western cavalry and infantry units are animated during moving and attacking melee or ranged.
[*]The musket fire creates smoke.
[*]Bloom effect added.
[*]Recolorization effect for more vivid colors.
[*]Borders are changed with influence map.
[*]Now the main camera can follow the selected unit if you choose.
[*]Fix: "Attack Not Allowed" UI image incorrectly showing when trying to attack peaceful opponents.
[*]New main menu logo updated.
[/list]

If you have missed the opportunity to join the playtest, you can now join until 7th of December.
